name: WF2 — Legal Topic Research and Ranking

parameters.jsonBody: ={"q": "{{ $json.keyword }} site:law.cornell.edu OR site:justia.com OR legal guide", "num": 5, "gl": "us", "hl": "en"}

parameters.prompt:
=You are a legal research expert for common-law.ai.

Analyze this topic candidate:
- Title: "{{ $json.title }}"
- Keyword: "{{ $json.keyword }}"
- Practice Area: {{ $json.practice_area }}
- Target State: {{ $json.target_state }}

Determine:
1. Primary jurisdiction (state, federal, or both)
2. Search intent type (informational, navigational, commercial, transactional)
3. Target audience (individuals, consumers, business owners)
4. Key legal authorities relevant to this topic (general statutes, case law areas — do NOT invent citations)
5. Competitor content angle (how top legal sites cover this)

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "jurisdiction": "state|federal|both",
  "jurisdiction_detail": "{{ $json.target_state }}",
  "search_intent": "informational|commercial|transactional",
  "target_audience": "Description of searcher",
  "legal_authority_areas": ["Relevant area 1", "Relevant area 2"],
  "competitor_angle": "Summary of current competitor coverage",
  "content_type_recommendation": "comprehensive guide|FAQ|explainer"
}
